comparison.objective: Undo a tight bolt using a ratchet initially set to tighten, then return the ratchet; candidate instead sets and locks a gripper opening stop and verifies cycling.
comparison.physical_skill: Selector flipping, socket seating, and repeated ratchet strokes versus simultaneous hex-driver counterholding and jam-nut tightening on a coupled adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Bolt backed out at least one turn and ratchet returned; over-tightening beyond 20° fails. Exact partial tiers are absent. Candidate requires retained 90° opening, locked nuts, three cycles, and released clearance.
comparison.reason: Both use rotary tools, but the record tests tool-mode recognition and one-way ratcheting, not preserving a screw setting while locking its concentric jam nut.
